messages:
Elena: Quick brainstorm  planning a 45m webinar: 'Practical Inference Economics' but framed as a 'benchmarks-as-narrative' session. Focus: cost/latency tradeoffs, two concrete workloads, and clear takeaways.

Elena: Draft abstract: 'We map production tradeoffs for inference: when batching and caching save dollars without breaking SLAs, how model routing shapes latency, and operational guardrails for reliable cost reduction.' Target audience: infra/platform + ML engineers and product managers.

Sam: Nice. Can we make it super actionable? e.g., 3 config knobs + real numbers.

Priya: Yes. Propose two tracks in the webinar: chat support (low-latency, high-concurrency) and embedding bulk-updates (throughput/cost). Demo each with before/after metrics + dashboard.

Ava: I'll run the runtime demo: kernel selection, quantization impact, and graceful fallback. Need 12-15m. Will prepare a short script for failover scenario.

Devon: I'll do the embedding case study: batch sizing, caching, and DB writeback. 18-20m including a short architecture diagram + metrics table.

Sam: Run-of-show proposal:
- 00:00-02:00 Elena: Welcome + objectives (2m)
- 02:00-18:00 Runtime demo (Ava) incl. recorded fallback (16m)
- 18:00-38:00 Embedding case (Devon) incl. Qs (20m)
- 38:00-44:00 Benchmarks narrative & 1-slide reproducible repo (Priya) (6m)
- 44:00-45:00 CTA, resources, lead routing callout (Sam) (1m)

Elena: Add 2m buffer after each live demo for tech resets. Also, assign slide ownership & CTS.

Priya: Slide owners: Intro (Elena), Runtime demo (Ava), Embedding case (Devon), Benchmarks + repo (Priya), CTA (Sam). I'll collate into a single deck.

Max: Logistics: I can schedule rehearsals. Ops recommends: Mon 16:00 full dry-run (with stage channel), Tue 09:30 technical check (infra-only), Wed 10:00 dress run. Which works?

Riley: Tue 09:30 and Wed 10 both good.

Devon: Tue 09:30 ok. Also will push a small 'webinar-3187' branch with scripts today.

Elena: We need two recorded fallbacks for demos (so we can switch to recording if live infra flakes). @OpsBot can you start a recording and post link? Also create a lightweight runbook with steps to swap to recorded demo.

OpsBot: [automated] Recording created: https://redwood-recordings/3187777777/runtime-demo-fallback.mp4 :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: [automated] Recording created: https://redwood-recordings/3187777777/embedding-demo-fallback.mp4 :white_check_mark:

Sam: Lead routing plan: primary -> SDR queue 'webinar-inbound'; high-fit enterprise -> AM handoff via webhook. Max please post webhook mapping + example payload in #marketing-assets.

Max: Will post mapping + example payload. Example payload (pseudocode):
```
POST /webhooks/leads HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "company": "ACME Corp",
  "score": "86",
  "source": "webinar:3187777777",
  "interest": "dedicated/private"
}
```

Priya: Also add a one-slide 'how to reproduce' with a tiny repo link and minimal scripts to run the demo locally. That increases adoption.

Devon: Repo: https://github.com/redwood/examples/tree/webinar-3187 (pushed). README contains a 'quickstart.sh' and test creds (dev-only).

Ava: Can we include a quick poll in the webinar: "Which constraint matters most? cost / latency / reliability". Helps segment follow-ups.

Elena: Good. We'll wire poll responses to the lead payload (field: 'primary_constraint').

Sam: Pre-webinar checklist to complete before Mon EOD:
- All slides in shared deck (owners confirmed)
- Demo creds & runbooks checked into staging (Ops)
- Two fallback recordings uploaded (OpsBot done)
- Lead routing webhook posted (Max)
- Calendar invites & Stage channel (Max)
- Rehearsal invites sent (Max)

Max: I'll post the webhook mapping in #marketing-assets and invite links are going out now.

Riley: One more ops note: Stage channel should have pinned 'switch to recording' steps and a single contact (Devon) for infra during the live event.

Elena: Assign Devon as infra lead. Also assign Sam as MC for chat triage.

Priya: We should prepare a short follow-up email template + lead scoring rubric for SDRs. I can draft the template.

Sam: Draft follow-up: thanks + link to deck + repo + request to book a demo if high-fit. Include poll summary.

Elena: Great. Last ask: please keep messages short in rehearsal and confirm when each checklist item is done. We'll do full dry-run Mon 16:00. See you then :rocket:
